paragraphs: On Thursday, the class plays football on the school field. It is hot, so Tom takes off his jacket. He puts it on the bench next to his bag. After the game, Tom gets dressed. He takes a dry T-shirt out of his bag. But his jacket is not on the bench! Tom looks sad. "Where is my jacket?" asks Tom. Lily and Ben come to help. "What does it look like?" asks Ben. "It is blue, and it has a white stripe," says Tom. Ben looks under the bench. Pip jumps off the bench and runs to the box.

Lily asks Coach Matt. He has a whistle around his neck. "Where is the box where we put lost jackets?" "It is next to the sports cupboard," says Coach Matt. "Which jacket is Tom's?" he asks. "It is the blue striped jacket which has a pocket," says Lily. They find two blue jackets in the box. One jacket is wrong because it has no pocket. The next one has a pocket, but it has no stripe. A boy in a green T-shirt says, "It is mine!" He is the boy who is in Tom's class.

Tom looks at the bottom of the box. Pip is asleep on top of a blue jacket! It is striped, and it has a pocket. "That is my jacket!" says Tom. Ben drops his ball and laughs. "Pip likes your jacket, Tom," he says. Tom drops his bag. He gives Pip a big hug. Lily smiles at Coach Matt and says, "Thank you!"
text.summary: After football, Tom cannot find his jacket. Lily, Ben, and Coach Matt help him, and Pip is asleep on the jacket in the lost-property box.
